topography.project_purpose: Abracadabra is a decentralized lending protocol that allows users to deposit interest-bearing tokens as collateral to mint MIM, a USD-pegged stablecoin. It also includes a DEX (MIM Swap) for trading MIM and other assets, and supports cross-chain operations via omnichain tokens.
topography.relationship_narrative: The lending markets (V2, V3, V4) rely on Boxes (Degenbox) for yield strategies and Spells for position management, while MIM Swap provides liquidity for the MIM stablecoin. Omnichain tokens extend MIM and SPELL across chains, and treasuries manage protocol revenue and incentives.
